newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MBFB, Cetelem sets up HUF 620 mln JV.
newsitem.headline: MBFB, Cetelem sets up HUF 620 mln JV.

text.p: A joint venture between France's Cetelem and Hungary's Magyar Befektetesi es Fejlesztesi Bank (MBFB) will have a capital of 620 million forints, an MBFB official said on Monday.

"The agreement was signed at the end of last week and the institution, giving consumer credit, will probably start operations at the beginning of 1997," an MBFB official, who wished to remain unnamed, told Reuters.

Cetelem said on Monday the unit, Magyar Cetelem Rt., will be a financial institution specializing in consumer credits and the MBFB official added the main area will be household durables, or so-called white and brown products.
MBFB expects to apply for banking supervision approval in October, by which time the necessary documentation would be ready.
